For GP-005-E01, payload_type, payload_name, and payload_encoded_product are marked missing despite explicit mentions of mRNA, siRNA, and Egfp in the approved sentences. The comparator is also missing despite explicit comparison between KC and hepatocytes. For GP-005-E02, the LNP formulation description is missing despite mention of 'LNP mixture', and additional experimental variables (pseudouridine modification, ribonuclease inhibitor) are not captured. GP-005-E03 is correctly marked as non-LNP with minimal issues.
